cues.zh: 假设你想预测某个输出值 y

cues.en: maybe you want to predict your score on test based on how many hours you sleep and

cues.en: how many hours you study

cues.zh: 也就是考试前一晚的情况。要用机器学习方法
cues.en: the night before. To use a machine learning approach

cues.zh: 我们首先需要一些数据。假设最近三次考试
cues.en: we first need some data. Let's say for the last three tests

cues.zh: 你记录了自己的学习小时数、睡眠小时数
cues.en: you recorded your number of hours studying, you number of hours sleeping,

cues.en: and your score on the test. We'll use the programming language Python

cues.zh: 把数据存储到二维的“numpy”数组中。现在我们有了数据
cues.en: to store data in two-dimensional "numpy" arrays. Now that we have some data

cues.zh: 接下来要用它训练一个模型，来预测你
cues.en: we're going to use it to train a model to predict how well you'll do

cues.zh: 在下一次考试中表现如何
cues.en: on your next test,

cues.zh: 依据是你睡了多少小时、学了多少小时。这叫做
cues.en: based on how many hours you sleep and how many hours you study. This is called a

cues.zh: 监督回归问题。
cues.en: supervised regression problem.

cues.zh: 这是监督学习，因为我们的样本既有输入
cues.en: It's supervised because our examples have inputs

cues.zh: 也有输出。这是一个回归问题，因为我们要预测你的考试
cues.en: and outputs. It's a regression problem because we're predicting your test

cues.zh: 成绩，它是一个
cues.en: score, which is a

cues.zh: 连续型输出。如果我们预测的是你的等级成绩（如A、B、C），
cues.en: continuous output. If, we were predicting your letter grade

cues.zh: 那它就属于分类问题，而不是回归问题了。
cues.en: this would be called a classification problem and not a regression problem.

cues.zh: 机器学习中的模型数量非常庞大，
cues.en: There are an overwhelming number of models within machine learning

cues.zh: 这里我们要用到一个特别有趣的，
cues.en: here we're going to use a particularly interesting one

cues.zh: 叫做人工神经网络，它大致借鉴了
cues.en: called an artificial neural network these guys are loosely based on how the

cues.zh: 人脑神经元的工作方式，
cues.en: neurons in your brain work

cues.zh: 并且最近在解决超大规模、
cues.en: and had been particularly successful recently at solving really big

cues.zh: 超高难度的复杂问题上尤为成功。
cues.en: and really hard problems

cues.zh: 在把数据喂给模型之前，我们需要解决
cues.en: before we throw our data into the model we need to account for the differences in

cues.zh: 数据单位不一致的问题。
cues.en: the units of our data.

cues.zh: 我们的两个输入都是以小时为单位，但
cues.en: Both of our inputs are on hours, but our

cues.zh: 输出却是考试成绩，范围在 0 到 100 之间。
cues.en: output is a test score, scaled between 0 and 100.

cues.zh: 神经网络很聪明，但还没聪明到能猜出我们数据的单位。
cues.en: Neural networks are smart, but not smart enough to guess the units of our data.

cues.zh: 这有点像让模型拿苹果和橘子作比较
cues.en: It's kinda like asking our model to compare apples to oranges

cues.zh: 而大多数学习模型其实只想拿苹果和苹果作比较。
cues.en: when most learning models really only want to compare apples to apples.

cues.zh: 解决办法是对数据做缩放，这样模型只会看到标准化的单位。
cues.en: The solution is to scale our data, thus our model will only see standardized units.

cues.zh: 这里我们要利用一个事实：我们的数据全是正值
cues.en: Here we're going to take advantage of the fact that all our data is positive

cues.zh: 只需对每个变量除以它的最大值
cues.en: and simply divide by the maximum value for each variable

cues.zh: 就能有效地把结果缩放到 0 到 1 之间。
cues.en: effectively scaling a result between 0 and 1.

cues.zh: 现在可以构建神经网络了。我们知道网络必须有两个输入，
cues.en: Now we can build our neural net. We know our network must have two inputs,

cues.zh: 和一个输出，因为这些正是我们数据的维度。
cues.en: and one output because these are the dimensions of our data.

cues.zh: 我们把输出层叫作 y hat，因为它是 y 的估计值，
cues.en: We'll call or output layer y hat, because it's an estimate of y,

cues.zh: 但并不等同于 y。输入层和输出层之间的任何层都叫作
cues.en: but not the same as y. Any layer between our input and output layers is called a

cues.zh: 隐藏层
cues.en: hidden layer

cues.en: recently researchers have built networks with many many many hidden layers

cues.zh: 这些被称为深度信念网络，由此产生了深度学习这个术语
cues.en: these are known as deep belief networks giving rise to the term deep learning

cues.zh: 这里我们用一层隐藏层，包含三个隐藏单元
cues.en: here going to use one hidden layer with three hidden units

cues.zh: 但如果我们想构建深度神经网络，只需把一堆这样的
cues.en: but if we wanted to build a deep neural network we would just stack a bunch of these

cues.zh: 层堆叠起来。
cues.en: layers together.

cues.zh: 在神经网络示意图中，圆圈代表神经元
cues.en: In neural net visuals, circles represent neurons

cues.zh: 线条代表突触
cues.en: and lines represent synapses

cues.zh: 突触的工作很简单，它从输入中取一个值，乘以一个
cues.en: Synapses have a really simple job, they take a value from their input, multiply it by a

cues.zh: 特定的权重
cues.en: specific weight

cues.zh: 然后输出结果。神经元则稍微复杂一些
cues.en: and output the result. Neurons are a little more complicated

cues.zh: 它的工作是把其他突触的输出加在一起
cues.en: their job is to add together the output from other synapses

cues.zh: 再应用激活函数。某些激活函数能让神经
cues.en: and apply an activation function. Certain activation functions allow neural

cues.zh: 网络建模复杂的
cues.en: nets to model complex

cues.zh: 非线性模式，而更简单的模型可能会漏掉这些。我们的神经网络将使用
cues.en: nonlinear patterns that simpler models may miss. For our neural net we'll use

cues.zh: sigmoid 激活函数。
cues.en: sigmoid activation functions.
